title: Testimonials Grid
description: Reusable, prop-driven testimonials section for marketing pages. Composes a header (eyebrow / title / subtitle) with a responsive 1-3 column grid of testimonial cards. Each item accepts quote, author, optional role, company, avatar, star rating, and featured flag. Three visual layouts: cards (shadcn Card grid), quote-stack (minimal centered quote flow), masonry (CSS columns flow).
